title: Mobile Performance & PageSpeed Optimizations
body:
- Enabled gzip compression and 24-hour browser caching for GeoJSON map files in Nginx, cutting map transfer sizes by ~75%.
- Lazy-loaded below-the-fold map thumbnails via IntersectionObserver so the homepage no longer fetches 2.15 MB of GeoJSON on initial load.
- Removed Framer Motion from the homepage hero, lazy-loaded the SpinningGlobe canvas, eliminated its 10x/sec React re-render loop, and scoped Google OAuth loading to `/login` and `/register` only.
